children: RNS Number : 6298U  Murray Income Trust PLC  14 September 2026
Murray Income Trust PLC announces an online presentation for retail shareholders and interested parties at 11am on 13 October 2026.

Chair, Peter Tait, and portfolio managers, Andy Marsh and Nick Shenton, will review Artemis's first six months managing the Company's portfolio in line with their longstanding UK equity income strategy. The Company, which aims to achieve a high and growing income combined with capital growth through investment in a portfolio principally of UK equities, currently has total assets of £1.0 billion.
Questions can be submitted during the presentation, and a recording will be made available on the Company's website after.
To register, please visit the www.murray-income.co.uk or click on the link below and follow the instructions.
